text:
marta: quick idea — let node sidecars propose local autofallbacks when they see bad signals (p99 latency spike or KV-miss surge).
kevin: fast, but auditability worry. how do we trace who initiated the fallback?
ryan: require each request to carry a decision_id and node signer id. central arbiter can accept/reject and we record the mapping.
jess: sidecars publish a compact decision_request event (decision_id, node, signal, value) to the pipeline; trace-db indexes the stream.
marta: UX: operator inbox card shows time, service, requestor, trigger, confidence, outcome. expand -> 20s signal trace + link to replay.
kevin: rollout policy toggle: "allow node-local fallback" with sub-options for threshold, cooldown, and notify-level. default OFF for SLA tenants.
sam: security: mTLS and per-node signer tokens; audit must include cert thumbprint. pilot behind feature flag and start in metrics-only mode.
ryan: mitigate flip-flop: sidecar requests are advisory; arbiter enforces hysteresis and global constraints. console displays "requested by X / applied by Y".
jess: operator override: sticky override with TTL and mandatory short annotation. retention: audit events 90d, exportable JSON/CSV.
ops-bot: NOTE: created ticket INFRA-1217 for local fallback pilot.
marta: next steps: eng-runtime add decision_id header (owner: jess, due: EOW); eng-platform design arbiter API + audit schema (owner: ryan, due: next Wed); ux inbox + timeline mock (owner: kevin, due: Tue).
